Script.name: imperium_cal_init
Script.script:
-- imperium_cal - Kalendarz Imperium dla Mudlet (port pluginu Dargoth) -- Zrodlo czasu: komenda "czas" (parsowana wlasnym kalendarzem). Brak zaleznosci od GMCP.
imperium_cal = imperium_cal or {}
do
local PLUGIN_VERSION = "1.8.23m" local PLUGIN_BUILD = "26-08-2026"
local REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE = 2 local YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS = 400 local GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY = 24 * 60 local REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S = 3.5
imperium_cal.version = PLUGIN_VERSION imperium_cal.build = PLUGIN_BUILD
local IMP_MONTHS = { { name = "Hexenstag", days = 1, sunrise = 8, sunset = 17 }, { name = "Nachexen", days = 32, sunrise = 8, sunset = 17 }, { name = "Jahrdrung", days = 33, sunrise = 7, sunset = 18 }, { name = "Mitterfruhl", days = 1, sunrise = 7, sunset = 18 }, { name = "Pflugzeit", days = 33, sunrise = 6, sunset = 19 }, { name = "Sigmarzeit", days = 33, sunrise = 5, sunset = 20 }, { name = "Sommerzeit", days = 33, sunrise = 5, sunset = 21 }, { name = "Sonnstill", days = 1, sunrise = 5, sunset = 22 }, { name = "Vorgeheim", days = 33, sunrise = 4, sunset = 22 }, { name = "Nachgeheim", days = 33, sunrise = 5, sunset = 21 }, { name = "Erntezeit", days = 33, sunrise = 5, sunset = 20 }, { name = "Mittherbst", days = 1, sunrise = 5, sunset = 20 }, { name = "Brauzeit", days = 33, sunrise = 6, sunset = 19 }, { name = "Kaldezeit", days = 33, sunrise = 6, sunset = 18 }, { name = "Ulriczeit", days = 33, sunrise = 7, sunset = 17 }, { name = "Mondstille", days = 1, sunrise = 8, sunset = 16 }, { name = "Vorhexen", days = 33, sunrise = 8, sunset = 16 }, }
local MONTH_ALIASES_TO_CANON = { nachhexen = "nachexen", sigmarszeit = "sigmarzeit", kaltezeit = "kaldezeit", ulrichszeit = "ulriczeit", sonnenstill = "sonnstill", sonnenstil = "sonnstill", sonnenstille = "sonnstill", mondstill = "mondstille", mitterherbst = "mittherbst", hexensnacht = "hexenstag", }
local function trim(s) return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function normalizeMonthKey(raw) local k = trim(raw):lower() return MONTH_ALIASES_TO_CANON[k] or k end
local MONTH_INDEX = {} for i, m in ipairs(IMP_MONTHS) do MONTH_INDEX[m.name:lower()] = i end for alias, canon in pairs(MONTH_ALIASES_TO_CANON) do local idx = MONTH_INDEX[canon] if idx then MONTH_INDEX[alias] = idx end end
local MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS = {} do local acc = 0 for _, m in ipairs(IMP_MONTHS) do MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS[#MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS + 1] = acc acc = acc + m.days end end
local NEW_MOONS = { { dayOfMonth = 13, month = "Nachexen" }, { dayOfMonth = 6, month = "Jahrdrung" }, { dayOfMonth = 31, month = "Jahrdrung" }, { dayOfMonth = 22, month = "Pflugzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 14, month = "Sigmarzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 6, month = "Sommerzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 31, month = "Sommerzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 22, month = "Vorgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 13, month = "Nachgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 6, month = "Erntezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 31, month = "Erntezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 22, month = "Brauzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 14, month = "Kaldezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 6, month = "Ulriczeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 31, month = "Ulriczeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 22, month = "Vorhexen" }, }
local FULL_MOONS = { { dayOfMonth = 25, month = "Nachexen" }, { dayOfMonth = 18, month = "Jahrdrung" }, { dayOfMonth = 9, month = "Pflugzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 2, month = "Sigmarzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 26, month = "Sigmarzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 18, month = "Sommerzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 9, month = "Vorgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 1, month = "Nachgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 26, month = "Nachgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 18, month = "Erntezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 9, month = "Brauzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 1, month = "Kaldezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 26, month = "Kaldezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 18, month = "Ulriczeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 9, month = "Vorhexen" }, }
local SEASONAL_EVENTS = { { dayOfYear = 18, name = "Pierwszy dzien wiosny" }, { dayOfYear = 118, name = "Pierwszy dzien lata" }, { dayOfYear = 218, name = "Pierwszy dzien jesieni" }, { dayOfYear = 319, name = "Pierwszy dzien zimy" }, }
local INTERCALARY_EVENTS = { { month = "Hexenstag", dayOfMonth = 1, name = "Hexentag" }, { month = "Mitterfruhl", dayOfMonth = 1, name = "Mitterfruhl" }, { month = "Sonnstill", dayOfMonth = 1, name = "Sonnstill" }, { month = "Mittherbst", dayOfMonth = 1, name = "Mittherbst" }, { month = "Mondstille", dayOfMonth = 1, name = "Mondstille" }, }
local INTERCALARY_MONTHS = {} for _, e in ipairs(INTERCALARY_EVENTS) do INTERCALARY_MONTHS[normalizeMonthKey(e.month)] = true end
-- Geheimnisnacht: EVENT podwojnej pelni (NIE dzien kalendarza). Osobna lista kandydatow. local GEHEIMNISNACHT_FULLS = { { dayOfMonth = 1, month = "Nachgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 26, month = "Nachgeheim" }, { dayOfMonth = 18, month = "Erntezeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 9, month = "Brauzeit" }, { dayOfMonth = 1, month = "Kaldezeit" }, }
local GN_WINDOW_START_MIN = 19 * 60 -- 19:00 = 1140 local GN_WINDOW_END_MIN = 21 * 60 -- 21:00 = 1260 local GN_PRIME_MIN = 20 * 60 -- 20:00 = 1200 (srodek okna) local GN_SCAN_YEARS = 4 -- ile kolejnych lat IG przeszukac (zapas) local GN_CLUSTER_S = 180 * 60 -- 3 h RL: prog "ten sam cykl" przy wyborze nocy
-- Europe/Warsaw bez zaleznosci od strefy systemowej (odpowiednik Intl timeZone z JS). -- CET = UTC+1, CEST = UTC+2; DST: ostatnia niedziela marca 01:00 UTC -> -- ostatnia niedziela pazdziernika 01:00 UTC. local function daysFromCivil(y, m, d) if m <= 2 then y = y - 1 end local era = math.floor(y / 400) local yoe = y - era * 400 local mp = (m + 9) % 12 local doy = math.floor((153 * mp + 2) / 5) + d - 1 return era * 146097 + yoe * 365 + math.floor(yoe / 4) - math.floor(yoe / 100) + doy - 719468 end
local function dstBoundaryUtcSec(year, month) -- marzec i pazdziernik maja po 31 dni; granica = ostatnia niedziela, 01:00 UTC local days = daysFromCivil(year, month, 31) local weekday = (days + 4) % 7 -- 0 = niedziela (epoch 1970-01-01 = czwartek) return daysFromCivil(year, month, 31 - weekday) * 86400 + 3600 end
local function warsawClockMinutes(tsSec) local utc = os.date("!*t", tsSec) local startSec = dstBoundaryUtcSec(utc.year, 3) local endSec = dstBoundaryUtcSec(utc.year, 10) local offMin = (tsSec >= startSec and tsSec < endSec) and 120 or 60 return (utc.hour * 60 + utc.min + offMin) % 1440 end
local function pad2(n) return string.format("%02d", n) end
local function normalizeDayOfYear(d) local m = ((d - 1) % YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS + YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS) % YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS return m + 1 end
-- Godzina zachodu slonca per dzien roku, wyliczona z tabeli miesiecy (clock.ts). local SUNSET_BY_DOY = {} do for i, m in ipairs(IMP_MONTHS) do local start = MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS[i] + 1 for d = 0, m.days - 1 do SUNSET_BY_DOY[start + d] = m.sunset end end end
local function sunsetHourForDoy(d) return SUNSET_BY_DOY[normalizeDayOfYear(d)] end
local SUNRISE_BY_DOY = {} do for i, m in ipairs(IMP_MONTHS) do local start = MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS[i] + 1 for d = 0, m.days - 1 do SUNRISE_BY_DOY[start + d] = m.sunrise end end end
local function sunriseHourForDoy(d) return SUNRISE_BY_DOY[normalizeDayOfYear(d)] end
local function clampInt(n, minv, maxv) if type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n then return minv end return math.max(minv, math.min(maxv, math.floor(n))) end
local function clampGameTime(t) return { dayOfYear = clampInt(t.dayOfYear, 1, YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS), hour = clampInt(t.hour, 0, 23), minute = clampInt(t.minute, 0, 59), } end
local function isValidGameTime(t) if not t then return false end if type(t.dayOfYear) ~= "number" or type(t.hour) ~= "number" or type(t.minute) ~= "number" then return false end return t.dayOfYear >= 1 and t.dayOfYear <= YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS and t.hour >= 0 and t.hour <= 23 and t.minute >= 0 and t.minute <= 59 end
local function deltaGameMinutes(from, to) local fromTotal = (from.dayOfYear - 1) * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY + from.hour * 60 + from.minute local toTotal = (to.dayOfYear - 1) * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY + to.hour * 60 + to.minute local yearTotal = YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY local diff = toTotal - fromTotal if diff < 0 then diff = diff + yearTotal end return diff end
local function formatRealDate(ts) local d = os.date("*t", ts) return string.format("%s-%s-%d %s:%s", pad2(d.day), pad2(d.month), d.year, pad2(d.hour), pad2(d.min)) end
local function truncateToMinute(ts) return math.floor(ts / 60) * 60 end
local function addGameMinutes(baseSec, deltaMin) return baseSec + deltaMin * REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE end
local function formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(deltaGM) local totalMinReal = math.max(0, math.floor((deltaGM * REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE) / 60 + 0.5)) local days = math.floor(totalMinReal / (60 * 24)) local hours = math.floor((totalMinReal % (60 * 24)) / 60) local minutes = totalMinReal % 60 return string.format("%dd %dh %dm", days, hours, minutes) end
local function dayOfYearFromMonthDay(monthName, dayOfMonth) local idx = MONTH_INDEX[normalizeMonthKey(monthName)] if not idx then return nil end local maxDay = IMP_MONTHS[idx].days if dayOfMonth < 1 or dayOfMonth > maxDay then return nil end return MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS[idx] + dayOfMonth end
local function monthDayFromDayOfYear(dayOfYear) local d = normalizeDayOfYear(dayOfYear) for i = #IMP_MONTHS, 1, -1 do if d > MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS[i] then return { month = IMP_MONTHS[i].name, dayOfMonth = d - MONTH_PREFIX_DAYS[i] } end end return nil end
local function toSortedDoyList(list) local out = {} for _, item in ipairs(list) do local doy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay(item.month, item.dayOfMonth) if doy then out[#out + 1] = normalizeDayOfYear(doy) end end table.sort(out) return out end
local function nextFromSortedList(now, sortedList) local nowDoy = normalizeDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) local atMidnight = (now.hour == 0 and now.minute == 0) for _, d in ipairs(sortedList) do if d > nowDoy then return d end if d == nowDoy and atMidnight then return d end end return sortedList[1] or 1 end
local function listContains(list, value) for _, v in ipairs(list) do if v == value then return true end end return false end
local function buildNewMoonDoyToIndexMap(sortedNewMoonDoy) local map = {} for i, md in ipairs(NEW_MOONS) do local doy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay(md.month, md.dayOfMonth) if doy then map[normalizeDayOfYear(doy)] = i end end for _, d in ipairs(sortedNewMoonDoy) do if not map[d] then return {} end end return map end
local function computeSanityAndLists() local fail = function() return { ok = false, newMoons = {}, fullMoons = {}, newMoonDoyToIndex = {} } end
local totalDays = 0 for _, m in ipairs(IMP_MONTHS) do totalDays = totalDays + m.days end if totalDays ~= YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS then return fail() end
for _, it in ipairs(NEW_MOONS) do if INTERCALARY_MONTHS[normalizeMonthKey(it.month)] then return fail() end end for _, it in ipairs(FULL_MOONS) do if INTERCALARY_MONTHS[normalizeMonthKey(it.month)] then return fail() end end
for _, t in ipairs({ NEW_MOONS, FULL_MOONS, INTERCALARY_EVENTS, GEHEIMNISNACHT_FULLS }) do for _, it in ipairs(t) do if not dayOfYearFromMonthDay(it.month, it.dayOfMonth) then return fail() end end end
for _, m in ipairs(IMP_MONTHS) do if type(m.sunrise) ~= "number" or m.sunrise < 0 or m.sunrise > 23 then return fail() end if type(m.sunset) ~= "number" or m.sunset < 0 or m.sunset > 23 then return fail() end end
for _, ev in ipairs(SEASONAL_EVENTS) do if type(ev.dayOfYear) ~= "number" or ev.dayOfYear < 1 or ev.dayOfYear > YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS then return fail() end end
local newMoons = toSortedDoyList(NEW_MOONS) local fullMoons = toSortedDoyList(FULL_MOONS) if #newMoons == 0 or #fullMoons == 0 then return fail() end
local newMoonDoyToIndex = buildNewMoonDoyToIndexMap(newMoons) if not next(newMoonDoyToIndex) then return fail() end
return { ok = true, newMoons = newMoons, fullMoons = fullMoons, newMoonDoyToIndex = newMoonDoyToIndex } end
local SANITY = computeSanityAndLists() imperium_cal.sanityOk = SANITY.ok
-- pushEventTimingLines: wspoldzielony helper "Dzis/TRWA TERAZ" vs "Data RL/Za". local function pushEventTimingLines(lines, now, nowReal, doy) local d = normalizeDayOfYear(doy) if normalizeDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) == d then local minutesToEndOfDay = (24 - now.hour) * 60 - now.minute local endReal = addGameMinutes(nowReal, minutesToEndOfDay) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Dzis (dzien %d)", d) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" TRWA TERAZ (do %s)", formatRealDate(endReal)) return end local deltaMin = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = d, hour = 0, minute = 0 }) local real = addGameMinutes(nowReal, deltaMin) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDate(real)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(deltaMin)) end
local function computeHexennacht(now) local yearTotal = YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY local nd = (24 - sunsetHourForDoy(1) + sunriseHourForDoy(2)) * 60 local base = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = 1, hour = sunsetHourForDoy(1), minute = 0 }) local db = base - yearTotal if db > -nd then return { trwa = true, deltaMin = nd + db } end return { trwa = false, deltaMin = base } end
local function computeGeheimnisnachtNight(now, nowReal) local yearTotal = YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY local cands = {}
for _, f in ipairs(GEHEIMNISNACHT_FULLS) do local fdoy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay(f.month, f.dayOfMonth) if fdoy then -- Noc Geheimnisnacht = sama noc pelni (offset 0 dni). local gnDoy = normalizeDayOfYear(fdoy) local gnSunsetH = sunsetHourForDoy(gnDoy) local gnSunriseH = sunriseHourForDoy(normalizeDayOfYear(gnDoy + 1)) local nightDur = (24 - gnSunsetH + gnSunriseH) * 60 local base = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = gnDoy, hour = gnSunsetH, minute = 0 })
-- TRWA: noc pelni zaczela sie mniej niz nightDur temu, wiec delta do -- nastepnego wystapienia zawinela sie przez koniec roku. Sprawdzane -- niezaleznie od okna - trwajacy event pokazujemy zawsze. if base > yearTotal - nightDur and base < yearTotal then return { trwa = true, deltaMin = base - (yearTotal - nightDur), nightDoy = gnDoy } end
for k = 0, GN_SCAN_YEARS - 1 do local dmAnchor = base + k * yearTotal local realAnchor = addGameMinutes(nowReal, dmAnchor) local clockA = warsawClockMinutes(realAnchor) if clockA >= GN_WINDOW_START_MIN and clockA <= GN_WINDOW_END_MIN then -- Przyszly event cands[#cands + 1] = { deltaMin = dmAnchor, nightDoy = gnDoy, realSec = realAnchor, dist = math.abs(clockA - GN_PRIME_MIN), } end end end end
if #cands == 0 then return nil end
local t0 = cands[1].realSec for _, c in ipairs(cands) do if c.realSec < t0 then t0 = c.realSec end end
local best = nil for _, c in ipairs(cands) do if c.realSec <= t0 + GN_CLUSTER_S then if best == nil or c.dist < best.dist or (c.dist == best.dist and c.realSec < best.realSec) then best = c end end end
if best then return { trwa = false, deltaMin = best.deltaMin, nightDoy = best.nightDoy } end return nil end
local function buildReport(nowRaw, nowSecOpt) local now = clampGameTime(nowRaw) local nowReal = truncateToMinute(nowSecOpt or os.time()) local lines = {}
local hexDoy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay("Hexenstag", 1) or 1
lines[#lines + 1] = "Glowne swieta interkalarne:" lines[#lines + 1] = " *** Hexentag ***" pushEventTimingLines(lines, now, nowReal, hexDoy)
local hn = computeHexennacht(now) lines[#lines + 1] = " *** Hexennacht ***" if hn.trwa then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" TRWA TERAZ (do %s)", formatRealDate(addGameMinutes(nowReal, hn.deltaMin))) else lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDate(addGameMinutes(nowReal, hn.deltaMin))) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(hn.deltaMin)) end
local gn = computeGeheimnisnachtNight(now, nowReal) if gn then local gnMd = monthDayFromDayOfYear(gn.nightDoy) local gnLabel if gnMd then gnLabel = string.format("%s %d, dzien %d", gnMd.month, gnMd.dayOfMonth, gn.nightDoy) else gnLabel = string.format("dzien %d", gn.nightDoy) end local gnReal = addGameMinutes(nowReal, gn.deltaMin) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" *** Geheimnisnacht (%s) ***", gnLabel) if gn.trwa then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" TRWA TERAZ (do %s)", formatRealDate(gnReal)) else lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDate(gnReal)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(gn.deltaMin)) end end
-- Najblizsze wydarzenie sezonowe local seasonalCandidates = {} for _, ev in ipairs(SEASONAL_EVENTS) do local doy = ev.dayOfYear local isToday = normalizeDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) == normalizeDayOfYear(doy) local dMin = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = doy, hour = 0, minute = 0 }) seasonalCandidates[#seasonalCandidates + 1] = { name = ev.name, dayOfYear = doy, isToday = isToday, deltaMin = dMin } end local seasonal = nil for _, c in ipairs(seasonalCandidates) do if c.isToday then seasonal = c break end end if not seasonal then local sorted = {} for _, c in ipairs(seasonalCandidates) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = c end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.deltaMin < b.deltaMin end) seasonal = sorted[1] end
lines[#lines + 1] = "" lines[#lines + 1] = "Najblizsze wydarzenie sezonowe:" if seasonal then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" %s", seasonal.name) pushEventTimingLines(lines, now, nowReal, seasonal.dayOfYear) end
-- Najblizsze wydarzenia ksiezycowe lines[#lines + 1] = "" lines[#lines + 1] = "Najblizsze wydarzenia ksiezycowe:"
local nowDoyForMoon = normalizeDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) local todayNewMoonIdx = SANITY.newMoonDoyToIndex[nowDoyForMoon] or -1
if todayNewMoonIdx >= 0 then local sunsetHour = sunsetHourForDoy(nowDoyForMoon) lines[#lines + 1] = " *** Now astronomiczny ***" pushEventTimingLines(lines, now, nowReal, nowDoyForMoon) if type(sunsetHour) == "number" and now.hour >= sunsetHour then local minutesToEndOfDay = (24 - now.hour) * 60 - now.minute local endReal = addGameMinutes(nowReal, minutesToEndOfDay) lines[#lines + 1] = " +++ Now widoczny TERAZ +++" lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" TRWA TERAZ (do %s)", formatRealDate(endReal)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Zachod: %s:00 IG", pad2(sunsetHour)) elseif type(sunsetHour) == "number" then local minutesToSunset = (sunsetHour - now.hour) * 60 - now.minute local sunsetReal = addGameMinutes(nowReal, minutesToSunset) lines[#lines + 1] = " +++ Now widoczny dzis po zachodzie slonca +++" lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDate(sunsetReal)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Zachod: %s:00 IG", pad2(sunsetHour)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(minutesToSunset)) end else local newDoy = nextFromSortedList(now, SANITY.newMoons) local newDeltaMin = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = newDoy, hour = 0, minute = 0 }) local newReal = addGameMinutes(nowReal, newDeltaMin) lines[#lines + 1] = " *** Now astronomiczny ***" lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDate(newReal)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(newDeltaMin))
local sunsetHour = sunsetHourForDoy(newDoy) if type(sunsetHour) == "number" then local sunsetDeltaMin = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = newDoy, hour = sunsetHour, minute = 0 }) local sunsetReal = addGameMinutes(nowReal, sunsetDeltaMin) lines[#lines + 1] = " +++ Now widoczny po zachodzie slonca +++" lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Data RL: %s", formatRealDate(sunsetReal)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Zachod: %s:00 IG", pad2(sunsetHour)) lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" Za: %s", formatRealDeltaFromGameMinutes(sunsetDeltaMin)) end end
local nowDoyForFull = normalizeDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) local fullDoy if listContains(SANITY.fullMoons, nowDoyForFull) then fullDoy = nowDoyForFull else fullDoy = nextFromSortedList(now, SANITY.fullMoons) end lines[#lines + 1] = " Pelnia astronomiczna" pushEventTimingLines(lines, now, nowReal, fullDoy)
-- Inne swieta interkalarne (bez Hexentag) local otherIntercalary = {} for _, ev in ipairs(INTERCALARY_EVENTS) do local low = ev.name:lower() if not low:find("hexentag", 1, true) then local doy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay(ev.month, ev.dayOfMonth) or 1 local isToday = normalizeDayOfYear(now.dayOfYear) == normalizeDayOfYear(doy) local dMin = deltaGameMinutes(now, { dayOfYear = doy, hour = 0, minute = 0 }) otherIntercalary[#otherIntercalary + 1] = { name = ev.name, dayOfYear = doy, sortKey = isToday and -1 or dMin } end end table.sort(otherIntercalary, function(a, b) return a.sortKey < b.sortKey end)
lines[#lines + 1] = "" lines[#lines + 1] = "Inne swieta interkalarne:" for _, ev in ipairs(otherIntercalary) do lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(" %s", ev.name) pushEventTimingLines(lines, now, nowReal, ev.dayOfYear) end
return lines end
-- ---------- Parsowanie odpowiedzi "czas" ---------- local POLISH_ORDINAL_DAY = { pierwszy = 1, drugi = 2, trzeci = 3, czwarty = 4, piaty = 5, szosty = 6, siodmy = 7, osmy = 8, dziewiaty = 9, dziesiaty = 10, jedenasty = 11, dwunasty = 12, trzynasty = 13, czternasty = 14, pietnasty = 15, szesnasty = 16, siedemnasty = 17, osiemnasty = 18, dziewietnasty = 19, dwudziesty = 20, trzydziesty = 30, ["dwudziesty pierwszy"] = 21, ["dwudziesty drugi"] = 22, ["dwudziesty trzeci"] = 23, ["dwudziesty czwarty"] = 24, ["dwudziesty piaty"] = 25, ["dwudziesty szosty"] = 26, ["dwudziesty siodmy"] = 27, ["dwudziesty osmy"] = 28, ["dwudziesty dziewiaty"] = 29, ["trzydziesty pierwszy"] = 31, ["trzydziesty drugi"] = 32, ["trzydziesty trzeci"] = 33, }
local function parsePolishOrdinalDay(words) local key = trim(words:lower():gsub("%-+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")) return POLISH_ORDINAL_DAY[key] end
local HOUR_WORD_VALUE = { polnoc = 0, pierwsza = 1, druga = 2, trzecia = 3, czwarta = 4, piata = 5, szosta = 6, siodma = 7, osma = 8, dziewiata = 9, dziesiata = 10, jedenasta = 11, dwunasta = 12, poludnie = 12, }
local HOUR_PREFIX = { w = true, po = true, przed = true, nad = true, poznym = true } local DAYTIME_SET = { dzien = true, nocy = true, poludniu = true, poludniem = true, poludnie = true, rano = true, ranem = true, wieczorem = true, }
-- 1:1 z parseHourFromCzasLine klienta: godzina + (opcjonalna) pora dnia + reguly PM. local function parseHourFromCzasLine(lc) local hourWord = lc:match("^jest w przyblizeniu (%a+)") if not hourWord then return nil end local value = HOUR_WORD_VALUE[hourWord] if type(value) ~= "number" then return nil end
local rest = lc:match("^jest w przyblizeniu %a+%s+(.*)$") or "" local firstWord = rest:match("^(%a+)") if firstWord and HOUR_PREFIX[firstWord] then rest = rest:gsub("^%a+%s*", "") end local dtWord = rest:match("^(%a+)") local daytime = (dtWord and DAYTIME_SET[dtWord]) and dtWord or ""
local hours = value if daytime == "poludniu" or daytime == "wieczorem" or (daytime == "nocy" and value >= 6) then hours = hours + 12 end if hours > 23 then hours = 0 end return hours end
local function matchMonthNameFromText(monthKey) local idx = MONTH_INDEX[normalizeMonthKey(monthKey)] if not idx then return nil end return IMP_MONTHS[idx].name end
local function tryParseCzasOutput(text) local hour = parseHourFromCzasLine(text:lower()) if hour == nil then return nil end local t = text:lower()
-- "X dzien miesiaca Y" (dzien podany slownie, 1-2 wyrazy) local before, monthKey = t:match("(.-)dzien miesiaca%s+(%a+)") if before and monthKey then before = trim(before) -- odcinamy klauzule godzinowa "jest w przyblizeniu ..., " zeby slowa godziny -- nie zlewaly sie z liczebnikiem dnia local dayPart = before:match("^jest w przyblizeniu .-,%s*(.-)%s*$") or before local dayNum = nil local w1, w2 = dayPart:match("(%a+)%s+(%a+)$") if w1 and w2 then -- dwuslowowy liczebnik spoza tabeli (np. "trzydziesty czwarty") = blad; -- BEZ fallbacku na ostatni wyraz (inaczej "34. dzien Nachexen" zawijal sie na doy 5) dayNum = parsePolishOrdinalDay(w1 .. " " .. w2) if not dayNum then return nil end else dayNum = parsePolishOrdinalDay(dayPart) end if not dayNum then return nil end local monthName = matchMonthNameFromText(monthKey) if not monthName then return nil end local doy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay(monthName, dayNum) if not doy then return nil end return { dayOfYear = doy, hour = hour, minute = 0 } end
-- "dzien/noc <Swieto> wedlug" (interkalarne) local hKey = t:match("dzien%s+(%a+)%s*[,%.]?%s*wedlug") or t:match("noc%s+(%a+)%s*[,%.]?%s*wedlug") if hKey then local monthName = matchMonthNameFromText(hKey) if not monthName then return nil end local doy = dayOfYearFromMonthDay(monthName, 1) if not doy then return nil end return { dayOfYear = doy, hour = hour, minute = 0 } end
return nil end
local function stripAnsi(s) return (s:gsub("\27%[[0-9;%?]*[ -/]*[@-~]", "")) end
local function sanitizeCzasLine(line) local s = stripAnsi(line or "") local bi = s:find("%[") if bi then s = s:sub(1, bi - 1) end s = s:gsub("^%s*>%s*", "") s = s:gsub("%s+", " ") return trim(s) end
local function isLikelyImperiumCzasLine(raw) local lc = raw:lower() if lc:sub(1, 19) ~= "jest w przyblizeniu" then return false end return lc:find("kalendarza imperialnego", 1, true) ~= nil end
local function isLikelyIshtarCzasLine(raw) local lc = raw:lower() if lc:sub(1, 19) ~= "jest w przyblizeniu" then return false end return lc:find("wedlug rachuby czasu starszego ludu", 1, true) ~= nil end
-- ---------- Wyjscie (kolory cecho, znormalizowane) ---------- local C_HEADER = "<yellow>" local C_STAR = "<cyan>" local C_NOW = "<green>" local C_DATA = "<white>" local C_SEP = "<cyan>" local C_RESET = "<reset>"
local function colorForLine(l) if l == "" then return C_RESET end if l:find("TRWA TERAZ", 1, true) or l:find("+++", 1, true) then return C_NOW end if l:find("***", 1, true) then return C_STAR end if l:sub(1, 1) ~= " " and l:sub(-1) == ":" then return C_HEADER end if l:sub(1, 4) == " " then return C_DATA end return C_DATA end
local function safeCecho(s) if cecho then cecho(s) else io.write((s:gsub("<%a+>", ""))) end end
local function printFramedReport(lines) safeCecho("\n\n" .. C_SEP .. "---" .. C_RESET .. "\n") for _, l in ipairs(lines) do safeCecho(colorForLine(l) .. l .. C_RESET .. "\n") end safeCecho(C_SEP .. "---" .. C_RESET .. "\n\n") end
local MSG_INTERNAL = { "[imperium_cal] Blad wewnetrzny kalendarza Imperium - nie mozna wyliczyc danych." } local MSG_GN_COLDSTART = { "[imperium_cal] Trwa Geheimnisnacht - komenda 'czas' nie podaje teraz daty.", "To pierwsze uzycie w tej sesji, wiec nie mam zapamietanej daty do wyliczenia.", "Uruchom /imperium raz poza Geheimnisnacht (gdy 'czas' pokazuje date) - potem zadziala tez w trakcie eventu.", } local MSG_TIMEOUT = { "[imperium_cal] Brak odpowiedzi na komende 'czas' (timeout) i nie mam zapamietanej daty.", "Sprawdz, czy 'czas' dziala, i sprobuj ponownie.", } -- Zla domena (A3) - komunikat 1:1 z klientem WWW. local MSG_CROSS_DOMAIN = { "[imperium_cal] Otrzymano czas Ishtar - postac jest w domenie Ishtar.", "Uzyj /ishtar zamiast /imperium.", }
local MSG_CROSS_NO_ANCHOR = { "[imperium_cal] Nie mam zapamietanej daty domeny Imperium - nie moge wyliczyc raportu.", "Bedac w domenie Imperium, uzyj komendy /imperium - odczyt zapisze date na przyszlosc.", }
local MSG_RESET_DONE = { "[imperium_cal] Kotwica Imperium wyczyszczona. Uzyj /imperium na zewnatrz, zeby zapisac nowa.", }
local function printUnable() printFramedReport(MSG_INTERNAL) end
local function printGnColdStart() printFramedReport(MSG_GN_COLDSTART) end
local function printTimeout() printFramedReport(MSG_TIMEOUT) end
local function runImperiumReport(now) if not SANITY.ok then printUnable() return end local ok = pcall(function() printFramedReport(buildReport(now)) end) if not ok then printUnable() end end
-- ---------- Stan i kotwica (w pamieci) ---------- local pendingRequest = false local requestStartSec = nil local anchor = nil -- { dayOfYear, hour, minute, rlSec }
-- ---------- Persystencja kotwicy (rekord v2 na dysku profilu) ---------- local ANCHOR_SCHEME = "hexenstag" local ANCHOR_FILENAME = "imperium_cal_anchor_v2.lua"
local function anchorFilePath() if not getMudletHomeDir then return nil end return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/" .. ANCHOR_FILENAME end
local function persistAnchorToDisk() if not anchor then return end if not (table.save and table.load) then return end local path = anchorFilePath() if not path then return end pcall(function() table.save(path, { scheme = ANCHOR_SCHEME, dayOfYear = anchor.dayOfYear, hour = anchor.hour, minute = anchor.minute, rlSec = anchor.rlSec, }) end) end
local function isValidAnchorRecord(a) if type(a) ~= "table" then return false end if a.scheme ~= ANCHOR_SCHEME then return false end if type(a.dayOfYear) ~= "number" or a.dayOfYear < 1 or a.dayOfYear > YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS then return false end if type(a.hour) ~= "number" or a.hour < 0 or a.hour > 23 then return false end if type(a.minute) ~= "number" or a.minute < 0 or a.minute > 59 then return false end if type(a.rlSec) ~= "number" or a.rlSec <= 0 then return false end return true end
local function loadPersistedAnchor() if not (table.save and table.load) then return end local path = anchorFilePath() if not path then return end local ok, rec = pcall(table.load, path) if not ok or not isValidAnchorRecord(rec) then return end anchor = { dayOfYear = rec.dayOfYear, hour = rec.hour, minute = rec.minute, rlSec = rec.rlSec, } end
local function clearPending() pendingRequest = false requestStartSec = nil end
local function saveTimeAnchor(dayOfYear, hour, minute) anchor = { dayOfYear = clampInt(dayOfYear, 1, YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS), hour = clampInt(hour, 0, 23), minute = clampInt(minute, 0, 59), rlSec = os.time(), } persistAnchorToDisk() end
local function extrapolateFromAnchor(a, nowSec) local elapsedSec = nowSec - a.rlSec if elapsedSec < 0 then return nil end local elapsedGameMinutes = math.floor(elapsedSec / REAL_SEC_PER_GAME_MINUTE) local yearTotal = YEAR_LENGTH_DAYS * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY local anchorTotal = (a.dayOfYear - 1) * GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY + a.hour * 60 + a.minute local nowTotal = ((anchorTotal + elapsedGameMinutes) % yearTotal + yearTotal) % yearTotal local rem = nowTotal % GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY return clampGameTime({ dayOfYear = math.floor(nowTotal / GAME_MINUTES_PER_DAY) + 1, hour = math.floor(rem / 60), minute = rem % 60, }) end
local function tryFinishFromAnchor() if not pendingRequest then return false end if not anchor then return false end local now = extrapolateFromAnchor(anchor, os.time()) if not isValidGameTime(now) then return false end clearPending() printFramedReport({ "[imperium_cal] Pokazuje Imperium wyliczone z zapisanej daty (ostatni odczyt: " .. os.date("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M", anchor.rlSec) .. ").", }) runImperiumReport(now) return true end
-- ---------- Handlery (wywolywane przez trigger / alias z XML) ---------- function imperium_cal.onCzasLine(lineText) local raw = sanitizeCzasLine(lineText) if not isLikelyImperiumCzasLine(raw) then return end
local parsed = tryParseCzasOutput(raw) if not isValidGameTime(parsed) then -- Rozpoznana linia 'czas' bez daty w klauzuli (event Geheimnisnacht) - -- NIGDY nie zapisuje kotwicy (O1). Bez pending: cicho. Z pending: -- nie zgaduj doy, uzyj WYLACZNIE kotwicy; brak kotwicy -> nie zgaduj. if not pendingRequest then return end if requestStartSec and os.time() - requestStartSec > REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.2 then return end if deleteLine then deleteLine() end if not tryFinishFromAnchor() then clearPending() printGnColdStart() end return end
-- O1: kotwica z KAZDEJ poprawnie sparsowanej linii wlasnej domeny, -- takze bez pending (np. linia z /pasek, reczne 'czas', cudzy skrypt). saveTimeAnchor(parsed.dayOfYear, parsed.hour, parsed.minute)
if not pendingRequest then return end -- Okno stale (paritet z www/dargoth): spozniona linia przy wiszacym -- pending nie dostaje gagu ani raportu; kotwica juz zapisana wyzej. if requestStartSec and os.time() - requestStartSec > REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.2 then return end
if deleteLine then deleteLine() end
clearPending() runImperiumReport(parsed) end
-- Zla domena (A3, jak w kliencie WWW): tylko przy wlasnym pending - -- komunikat, gag linii, kasowanie pending (bez timeoutu); potem raport -- zadanej domeny z jej zapisanej daty (wariant A) lub komunikat S6. function imperium_cal.onCrossLine(lineText) if not pendingRequest then return end if requestStartSec and os.time() - requestStartSec > REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.2 then return end local raw = sanitizeCzasLine(lineText) if not isLikelyIshtarCzasLine(raw) then return end
if deleteLine then deleteLine() end
clearPending() printFramedReport(MSG_CROSS_DOMAIN)
-- Wariant A: raport zadanej domeny z jej wlasnej zapisanej daty (bez delt -- miedzy domenami). Brak zapisanej daty -> komunikat S6. local now = anchor and extrapolateFromAnchor(anchor, os.time()) or nil if now and isValidGameTime(now) then printFramedReport({ "[imperium_cal] Pokazuje Imperium wyliczone z zapisanej daty (ostatni odczyt: " .. os.date("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M", anchor.rlSec) .. ").", }) runImperiumReport(now) else printFramedReport(MSG_CROSS_NO_ANCHOR) end end
function imperium_cal.onAlias() if not SANITY.ok then printUnable() return end if pendingRequest then return end
pendingRequest = true requestStartSec = os.time() if send then send("czas", false) end
if tempTimer then tempTimer(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S + 0.05, function() if not pendingRequest then return end if tryFinishFromAnchor() then return end clearPending() printTimeout() end) end end
-- /imperium reset (G2): czysci WYLACZNIE kotwice wlasnej domeny (RAM + plik), -- nie rusza cache'u updatera ani niczego innego. Idempotentny. Kotwica -- nie wygasa - reset to swiadome czyszczenie na zadanie gracza. function imperium_cal.onReset() anchor = nil local path = anchorFilePath() if path and os.remove then os.remove(path) end printFramedReport(MSG_RESET_DONE) end

-- ==================================================== autoaktualizacja -- Repo publiczne na GitHub: releases/latest (anonimowe API) -> asset -- .mpackage -> uninstallPackage -> installPackage (wzorzec skryptow -- aktualizacji Tjurczyka). Check przy starcie z throttlem 8 h (cache na -- dysku profilu); miedzy checkami powiadomienie odtwarzane z knownLatest. -- Komenda /imperium aktualizuj pomija throttle. -- Stala tozsamosc paczki (F1/F2): download do <pkg>.mpackage i sweep -- legacy nazw przed instalacja (mudlet-web nazywa paczke od pliku). local UPDATE_REPO = "arkadia-mudlet-calendar_imperium" local UPDATE_PKG_NAME = "imperium_cal" local UPDATE_CMD = "/imperium aktualizuj" local UPDATE_THROTTLE_SEC = 8 * 3600 local UPDATE_API_URL = "https://api.github.com/repos/Isithunzi000/" .. UPDATE_REPO .. "/releases/latest" local UPDATE_CACHE_PATH = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/imperium_cal_update_cache.lua" -- Historyczne nazwy paczek na mudlet-web (tozsamosc = nazwa pliku): -- wersjonowane assety release + dawniej <pkg>_update. Komplet wg -- Releases API + wersje z dzur (14-16m); self = kamizelka na lokalne buildy. local UPDATE_LEGACY_PKGS = { "imperium_cal_update", "imperium_cal_1_8_12m", "imperium_cal_1_8_13m", "imperium_cal_1_8_14m", "imperium_cal_1_8_15m", "imperium_cal_1_8_16m", "imperium_cal_1_8_17m", "imperium_cal_1_8_18m", "imperium_cal_1_8_19m", "imperium_cal_" .. PLUGIN_VERSION:gsub("%.", "_"), }
local updateDlHandlers = {} local updateMetaPath = nil local updatePkgPath = nil local updatePendingVersion = nil local updateManual = false
local function updateCacheRead() local t = {} local ok, res = pcall(table.load, UPDATE_CACHE_PATH, t) if ok and res then return t end return {} end
local function updateCacheWrite(latest) pcall(table.save, UPDATE_CACHE_PATH, { lastCheck = os.time(), knownLatest = latest }) end
local function updateVersionParts(v) local parts = {} for seg in tostring(v):gmatch("[^%.]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = tonumber(seg:match("^%d+")) or 0 end return parts end
-- Porownanie numeryczne segmentow (suffix literowy pomijany): 1.8.9m < 1.8.16m. local function updateVersionNewer(a, b) local pa, pb = updateVersionParts(a), updateVersionParts(b) for i = 1, math.max(#pa, #pb) do local x, y = pa[i] or 0, pb[i] or 0 if x ~= y then return x > y end end return false end
local function updateSay(msg) safeCecho(C_HEADER .. "[imperium_cal] " .. msg .. C_RESET .. "\n") end
local function updateNotify(latest) safeCecho("\n" .. C_HEADER .. "[imperium_cal] Dostepna nowa wersja " .. latest .. " (masz " .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. "). Wpisz " .. C_NOW .. UPDATE_CMD .. C_RESET .. C_HEADER .. " aby zaktualizowac." .. C_RESET .. "\n\n") end
local function updateFail(what) updateSay("Nie udalo sie " .. what .. " - sprobuj pozniej.") end
local function updateKillHandlers() for k, id in pairs(updateDlHandlers) do killAnonymousEventHandler(id) updateDlHandlers[k] = nil end end
local function updateOnError(event) updateKillHandlers() updateMetaPath = nil updatePkgPath = nil updatePendingVersion = nil updateFail("sprawdzic aktualizacji") end
local function updateOnPkgDone(event, path) if path ~= updatePkgPath then return end updateKillHandlers() local v = updatePendingVersion updatePkgPath = nil updatePendingVersion = nil pcall(uninstallPackage, UPDATE_PKG_NAME) for _, legacyName in ipairs(UPDATE_LEGACY_PKGS) do pcall(uninstallPackage, legacyName) end tempTimer(1, function() installPackage(path) os.remove(path) updateSay("Zaktualizowano do wersji " .. v .. ". Zrestartuj Mudleta, aby zmiany zadzialaly.") end) end
local function updateOnMetaDone(event, path) if path ~= updateMetaPath then return end updateMetaPath = nil if updateDlHandlers.meta then killAnonymousEventHandler(updateDlHandlers.meta) updateDlHandlers.meta = nil end local ok, meta = pcall(function() local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then error("brak pliku metadanych") end local body = f:read("*a") f:close() return yajl.to_value(body) end) if not ok or type(meta) ~= "table" or type(meta.tag_name) ~= "string" then updateKillHandlers() updateFail("sprawdzic aktualizacji") return end local latest = meta.tag_name:gsub("^v", "") updateCacheWrite(latest) if not updateVersionNewer(latest, PLUGIN_VERSION) then updateKillHandlers() if updateManual then updateSay("Masz najnowsza wersje (" .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. ").") end return end if not updateManual then updateKillHandlers() updateNotify(latest) return end local url = nil if type(meta.assets) == "table" then for _, a in ipairs(meta.assets) do if type(a) == "table" and type(a.browser_download_url) == "string" and a.browser_download_url:match("%.mpackage$") then url = a.browser_download_url break end end end if not url then url = "https://github.com/Isithunzi000/" .. UPDATE_REPO .. "/releases/download/v" .. latest .. "/" .. UPDATE_PKG_NAME .. ".mpackage" end updatePendingVersion = latest updatePkgPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/" .. UPDATE_PKG_NAME .. ".mpackage" updateDlHandlers.pkg = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", updateOnPkgDone) downloadFile(updatePkgPath, url) end
local function startUpdateCheck(manual) updateManual = manual and true or false if mudletOlderThan and mudletOlderThan(4, 6) then if updateManual then updateSay("Aktualizator wymaga Mudleta 4.6 lub nowszego.") end return end if not updateManual then local cache = updateCacheRead() local lastCheck = tonumber(cache.lastCheck) or 0 if os.time() - lastCheck < UPDATE_THROTTLE_SEC then if type(cache.knownLatest) == "string" and updateVersionNewer(cache.knownLatest, PLUGIN_VERSION) then updateNotify(cache.knownLatest) end return end end updateMetaPath = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/" .. UPDATE_PKG_NAME .. "_update_meta.json" updateDlHandlers.meta = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", updateOnMetaDone) updateDlHandlers.err = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", updateOnError) downloadFile(updateMetaPath, UPDATE_API_URL) end
function imperium_cal.onAktualizuj() startUpdateCheck(true) end
function imperium_cal_init(event, arg) if event == "sysInstallPackage" and arg ~= "imperium_cal" then return end loadPersistedAnchor() tempTimer(10, function() startUpdateCheck(false) end) if SANITY.ok then if cecho then cecho("<green>[imperium_cal]<reset> Kalendarz Imperium v" .. PLUGIN_VERSION .. " zaladowany. Wpisz <yellow>/imperium<reset> (pomoc: <yellow>/imperium help<reset>).\n") end else if cecho then cecho("<red>[imperium_cal]<reset> BLAD: dane kalendarza nie przeszly weryfikacji.\n") end end end
